'''Chamber 9''' was a finely-furnished room in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Rothe Gate]]. Its door had a numeric passcode.

Crimelord [[Nirama]] had an audience and survived an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt in Chamber 9 in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
